Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly “normalized” the Transformer encoder’s 6 layers to 12 by counting each layer’s two sublayers as separate layers, then concluded the difference is 0. Under the standard and paper-defined counting, BERT-base has 12 encoder layers and the original Transformer encoder has 6, so the correct difference is 6. The error arose from misinterpreting sublayers as layers and not relying on primary-source quotes to confirm counts.
